purpose: Genuinely new solitary cricket material for a steady, slow, quiet phone bed; final natural notes are arranged on one coherent offline cadence, not overlapping independent choruses.

assets.title: Steady solitary cricket
assets.role: One new low-mid cricket voice with short dry insect notes and slow even rests
assets.prompt: TrackType: SFX, A single solitary field cricket gives short soft dry chirrup notes in still tropical night air. One small grainy insect chirp, then a long quiet pause, then another: a steady unhurried even rhythm, roughly one brief chirrup every second. Each note is compact, around a tenth of a second, with a soft papery rasp and a rounded medium register. Clean isolated insect detail with quiet background air. One cricket only, no overlapping insect chorus, no fast tremolo, no birds, no whistling, no music. Length: 10 seconds.
